observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a Nikon DSLR camera body from the front, with 'Nikon' and partial 'D610' lettering visible on the body.
No lens is attached; the body cap/mount ring is exposed in both front shots.
The grip area (bottom front, right side) shows a frayed or peeling rubber/foam edge, visible in photo 0 and 1.
Photo 2 shows the top panel: hot shoe cover looks dusty/worn, mode dial and top LCD are visible, and the top LCD displays a faint readout ('-3-' or similar), suggesting the camera can power on.
No battery, charger, memory card, lens, strap, or box are shown in any photo.
No rear LCD screen, battery compartment, or memory card slot is visible in any photo.
Decorative plant in background is irrelevant prop, not part of the sale.
Watermark 'Posted on Jiji' and seller name overlay the images, consistent with a marketplace listing screenshot, not independent proof of condition.

claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 show visible wear: frayed/peeling grip material at bottom front edge, and photo 2 shows a dusty/worn hot shoe cover.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears
claims.evidence: Photo 0, 1 (grip wear) and photo 2 (dust on hot shoe, scuffed top plate).
No battery, charger, or accessories are shown in any of the 3 photos; the claim text is also cut off.

risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or a test shot's EXIF data

risks.risk: No lens included, but price expectations may assume a kit
risks.proof: Photo showing a lens bundled with the body, if one is included

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, fungus) cannot be seen without lens off and test image
risks.proof: A sample photo taken with the camera, or a clear shot of the sensor
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor condition unknown/worst case

risks.risk: Rear LCD screen condition and functionality not shown
risks.proof: Photo of the rear screen powered on, showing a live view or menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as rear screen possibly faulty

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and memory card authenticity/inclusion unverified
risks.proof: Photo of the actual battery, charger, and any card included, laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as body-only with no accessories

risks.risk: Frayed grip material may indicate deeper body wear or prior drop/repair

risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically and possibly structurally worn

risks.risk: General power-on/functional status beyond the top LCD readout is unconfirmed (autofocus, shutter firing, image capture)

proof_requests: Video or screenshot showing the shutter actuation count from the camera's menu
Short video clip of the camera powering on, autofocusing, and firing the shutter
Photo of the rear LCD screen turned on
Photo of the actual battery, charger, and memory card (if included) laid next to the camera
Close-up photo of the sensor (with lens/body cap removed) for dust/scratch/fungus check
Clear photo of the full front badge showing 'D610' text unobstructed
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Nikon D610 body from the front badge, but it is sold without a lens or visible accessories, shows cosmetic wear (frayed grip, dusty hot shoe), and has no proof of shutter count, sensor condition, or functional status, so it must be priced at worst case as a body-only, unverified-condition unit.
